name: Explosion
primary:
Three spinning crimson magic circles stack above the aimed spot for 2 s, then a pillar of light strikes it. Everyone within 16 blocks:
• Fire damage: 10 ❤ at the centre, 4 ❤ at the edge
• Heat 120
• Thrown far away
It blasts a crater 14 blocks in radius (up to 3000 blocks) and leaves a mushroom cloud.
Daze: everyone within 20 blocks, you included, cannot cast for 3 s and is slowed. Throw it far.
self_description: The blast goes off at your feet and throws you high into the air with slow falling for 8 s; you take no damage from it, but the daze is yours.
